title: Elimination or reduction in size of non-bonused open area
previewText: Any existing open area for which a floor area bonus has not been utilized that occupies the same zoning lot as an existing plaza, residential plaza or urban plaza, for which a floor area bonus has been utilized, may be reduced in size or eliminated only upon certification of the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission that all bonused amenities comply with the standards under which such floor area bonus was grant
